_comment: Bleakhold Royale v2: the same map (id 901, BleakholdRoyale, zone 5200 and its subzones) with the bright
tropical atmosphere of the v2 terrain (specs/royale_v2.json, 'Sunglass Lagoon'). package.py build reads it
like bleakhold_royale.json (see its _comment); only the atmosphere and the subzone names differ. The ids
below are from the stock 3.3.5a DBCs (asset kit v2, README_v2.md 'Atmosphere'):
map.time_of_day_override 720: a fixed noon (minutes; the client uses 720 / 1440 as the time of day), so the
map is never dark: the highest sun, the strongest ambient light and the shortest shadows. Ring of Valor
(map 618) ships the same value. 840 (early afternoon) is the alternative.
light.params_from_light 1690: Sholazar Basin's light set, copied whole (all 8 LightParams slots, so
underwater and ghost lighting stay right): the bluest bright sky, warm sun, strong ambient light and the
clearest water of the tropical candidates, with Sholazar's faint aurora overlay. Alternatives: 9
(Stranglethorn, no skybox model), 536 (Nagrand's skybox), or the Nagrand skybox by name ("skybox"
matches the DBC's .mdx spelling with either .mdx or .M2).
zone.template 490 (Un'Goro Crater): its AmbientMultiplier is 0.6 (Stranglethorn's is 0.3), so characters
are lit brighter, and its only flag, ALLOW_DUELS (0x40, the same as Stranglethorn's), is in clear_flags;
report.txt lists the final flags. It has none of the OUTLAND flags that Sholazar Basin (3711) carries.
ambience_id 32, zone_music 3 and intro_sound 0 keep Stranglethorn's jungle ambience and music, the sounds
Echo Isles uses, over the template's own (Un'Goro's are 33 and 223).
zone.subzones: the v2 names (all original; none is, or is part of, a stock AreaTable name). Totem Knoll,
Heron Rise, Salvagers' Camp and the Tidewalk are POIs only (ids 5214-5217), shown in zone 5200 or 5204.
archives.marker_texture MarkerV2.blp (v1: Marker.blp): the addon's patch gate (Royale.lua R.MARKER) tests
it, so a client that still has v1's patch-Q (v1 terrain under the same map id) cannot queue onto v2.
